title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash - 15s Product Videos
content:
Google ne 5 Nov 2026 ko Gemini Omni 1.2
Flash generally available kiya.
Native video ab up to 15 SECONDS - pehle
Omni 1.1 pe 10 seconds tha.
Agar tum product photo se short ad banana
chahte ho, yeh update directly tumhare
workflow mein padta hai.
End pe Comment keyword dunga - link DM mil jayega.

Verified facts, Google blogs se.
GA on the Gemini API aur Google Cloud.
Duration 3 se 15 seconds, 1-second steps mein.
Price $0.07 PER SECOND for 720p.
Price 30% LOWER than Omni 1.1.
Multi-turn conversational editing - same
clip pe follow-up edits, pura regenerate
nahi.
Draft 360p ya 720p, phir best ones upscale
to 1080p ya 4K.
Outputs pe SynthID watermark.

Google Vids side pe bhi clear offer hai.
Google account ya Google Workspace ke
saath, up to 3 15-SECOND VIDEOS per
month free in Vids.
Link Vids blog pe confirmed: Omni 1.2
Flash in Google Vids.
Matlab weekend pe bina card ke try kar
sakte ho, limit ke andar.

Practical how-to.
Ek clean product photo lo - packaging,
hero angle, brand colors visible.
Prompt mein duration 15 seconds set karo,
aspect ratio apne platform ke hisaab se.
Pehle 720p draft. Multi-turn se
background, lighting, ya text tweak karo.
Jab motion aur brand details lock ho
jayein, tab 1080p ya 4K upscale.
SynthID rahega - disclose AI-generated jab
platform maange.

Kyun yeh catalog teams ke kaam ka hai.
Google claim: stronger reference adherence
- faces, garments, packaging typography,
brand colors across angles.
Maan lo tumhare paas 20 SKUs ki stills hain.
Har SKU ka 15-second spin ya lifestyle
clip draft karo.
Human review: galat logo, morphing label,
weird hands - reject aur edit.
Volume AI se, brand safety human se.

Cost math simple rakho.
$0.07 per second at 720p - 15-second clip
roughly around $1.05 at that rate before
you count upscales and retries.
Isliye workflow: cheap draft,
conversational fix, sirf winners upscale.
30% lower than 1.1 is meaningful jab tum
mahine ke hundreds of SKU clips banao.
Still: measure your own bill. Main Google
ka pricing page parrot kar raha hoon,
tumhara invoice alag ho sakta hai with
resolution mix.

Mera take simple hai.
15 seconds ek full social ad beat hai -
hook, product, CTA - ek generation mein.
Omni 1.2 Flash tab jeetega jab tum
stills-to-video ops discipline se chalao:
references tight, multi-turn edits, human
QC.
Hype model name mat becho. Ship a weekly
catalog video ritual.

COMMENT OMNI, main Google blog link DM kar dunga.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
